subject.title: Chronic agent failures on Telegram — LLM timeouts before configured timeout + silent incomplete turns + dead fallbacks (OpenRouter/DeepSeek+V4-Flash, v2026.5.28)

question: For replay-unsafe DeepSeek/OpenRouter incomplete turns after tool activity, should OpenClaw retry despite possible side effects, keep fail-closed with clearer delivery, or split this issue into live-log correlation only?
rationale: Current source can explain why replay-unsafe turns fail closed, but the safety tradeoff of retrying after tool side effects needs maintainer product intent.

options.title: Keep fail-closed and correlate logs
options.body: Keep this issue open only for current-release log/config correlation while using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657 for the retry policy decision.

options.title: Allow guarded retry
options.body: Define a narrow replay policy that can retry selected incomplete post-tool turns without duplicating side effects, then require focused tests and live provider proof.

options.title: Close as duplicate after linking diagnostics
options.body: Move the reporter's useful logs to the canonical issue and close this composite report once maintainers decide no separate timeout/fallback work remains.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed and correlate logs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only for current-release log/config correlation while using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657 for the retry policy decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is runtime policy rather than a single code owner patch, and steipete has prior history on the timeout/fallback policy path.
